concerns.text: The plan evaluates the core scientific hypothesis—whether SNPs and MGE proximity add predictive value beyond ARGs—using a fully synthetic dataset. Synthetic data are generated deterministically and do not reflect real genotype‑phenotype relationships, so performance metrics (AUC, delta, McNemar p‑values) are not independent of the data generation process. This makes the validation circular and the claimed results non‑empirical; they cannot support the biological claim about real bacterial resistance.
